about: EACH SMALL MODEL'S ORIGINAL WEIGHTS, by the GGUF file the swarm serves: what MLX trains an adapter from (it cannot train a GGUF). training/mlx-setup.sh fetches each into .work/mlx/hf/<dir> at the revision named (include: only those files, where a repository holds more than one copy of the weights). cannot: why that one is not trained here, measured. Read by training/adapters.mjs and the page.

Ternary-Bonsai-2-4B-Q2_0.gguf.cannot: only its ternary, Hadamard-rotated weights are published: the trainer here (mlx-lm) does not load them, and its maker documents no way to train an adapter on them
